title: Zoo Ops
tagline: Ten guided levels. Fill in the TODOs, the keepers wake up.

levels.label: Cache
levels.title: The Nut Store
levels.without: Hazel keeps the Owl's answers in her nut store so visitors do not wait for the slow, expensive Owl every time.
levels.with: Hazel serves repeated questions from the nut store. The Owl only works on new ones.

levels.label: Rate limiting + API gateway
levels.title: The Gate
levels.without: Gus guards the gate in front of the Owl. A pigeon flock spams requests and a python sends giant prompts.
levels.with: Gus lets the hedgehog through and throttles the pigeons. The Owl stays calm.

levels.label: Reliability of external calls
levels.title: The Bridge
levels.without: Rusty carries questions across the bridge to the Owl. A storm hits: the Owl stops answering and the Parrot is the backup model.
levels.with: Rusty retries with jitter, stops hammering the dead Owl and falls back to the Parrot.

levels.label: Idempotency
levels.title: The Food Bowl
levels.without: Miso orders meals through a flaky network. Every lost response triggers a retry. Without idempotency, Miso eats everything twice.
levels.with: Every meal is served exactly once, no matter how often the client retries.

levels.label: Observability
levels.title: The Lookout
levels.without: Mika watches the zoo from the lookout: JSON logs, request ids, p95 latency and SLO alerts when the sloth exhibit gets slow.
levels.with: Mika traces every request, spots the slow sloth path and pages only on real incidents.

levels.label: Database performance
levels.title: The Burrows
levels.without: Digby digs through the animal registry. Every useless query is one more tunnel.
levels.with: Digby reads the catalog with one index, one query per page and a shared pool.

levels.label: Data integrity
levels.title: The Dam
levels.without: Bea keeps the books straight: food moves between pantries, two families try to adopt the same kitten, and a column migrates while the zoo stays open.
levels.with: No food is created or lost, each kitten has one family, the migration never blocks.

levels.label: Async processing
levels.title: The Anthill
levels.without: Ants carry background jobs. Rotten leaves (poison jobs) must go to the lost and found instead of blocking the colony. The Owl streams its answers word by word.
levels.with: The colony delivers every job, quarantines poison ones and streams the Owl live.

levels.label: Auth + security
levels.title: The Kennel
levels.without: Rex checks every badge. A raccoon from the Lyon shelter tries to read the Paris shelter's animals with forged and expired tokens.
levels.with: Rex lets keepers in and keeps the raccoon out of every other tenant.

levels.label: Deployment + scaling
levels.title: The Nest
levels.without: Pip tests every new release first. A bad song version must roll back, a good one must ship, and shutting down must never drop a request.
levels.with: Pip rolls back the broken release, promotes the good one and drains cleanly.
